name: HumanRequestService
logic_name: Durable Human Request and Answer Protocol

test_list.description: Every question is represented in the atomic answer batch; optional omissions use an explicit Unanswered response rather than a default.
Required choice questions cannot inherit a preselection or be submitted unanswered.
The typed NoneOfTheAbove sentinel cannot be combined with provider-defined option ids.
Answer validation rejects a stale immutable digest, unknown question ids, and a response kind that differs from its question.
Request construction enforces the question count and encoded payload bounds before persistence.
A valid verified command stores one full answer batch in CAS, appends a durable answered event, and resolves the waiting request only after persistence.
Unknown ids, missing required answers, stale revisions, cross-session/frame answers, and conflicting command reuse are rejected without a partial terminal transition.
Concurrent answer and requester interruption serialize under the writer lock; exactly one terminal event is durable.
Reopening a kernel reconstructs pending requests and preserves answered/interrupted terminal outcomes without reviving them.
host answer resumes only its pending request
host answer rejects untrusted control token
human request rejects missing durable witness before terminal event

inputs.name: request / answer / interrupt
inputs.type: validated request document, verified answer command, requester frame cancellation
inputs.description: Untrusted bounded request or answer payload plus actual session/frame binding supplied by the kernel composition root.

output_description: Durable request state and waiter outcome, or a typed rejection that leaves the prior state unchanged.
